source.title: WCA Server Move
source.content:
The WCA website team has just completed a move of www.worldcubeassociation.org to a new server. All parts of the site should be up and running again.
 
 If you are encountering new issues, please [contact the wca-website team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website).

translation.title: WCA 服务器迁移完成
translation.content:
WCA 网站团队刚刚完成 www.worldcubeassociation.org 向新服务器的迁移。网站各部分应已恢复正常运行。

如果遇到新的问题，请[联系 WCA 网站团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact/website)。
